## Change the default generation model to Haiku 4.5. — 2026-08-01 (parent 49ec6cae6ff5)

**Switch the default generation model from Claude Sonnet 4.6 to Claude Haiku 4.5 (anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) for lower cost by default.**

The default model for both `Models.bootstrap` and `Models.cascade` is changed from `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6` to `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`. Haiku 4.5 already has a pricing entry and is meaningfully cheaper; users who want richer prose can override via `--model` or their config file.

`DEFAULT_CONFIG_TOML` is updated in lock-step so the generated `trie.toml` template reflects the new default and includes a comment pointing to Sonnet as the higher-quality alternative.

The test `test_overrides_merge_per_section` is updated so its untouched-default assertion checks against the new Haiku 4.5 value rather than Sonnet 4.6.
